title: Umami Rich Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A creamy and umami-rich Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, liquid cheese, and puff pastry, cooked to perfection in an agave leaf vessel. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe is perfect for a lazy Sunday.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with cumin and coriander.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle, about 1/4-inch thick.
Spoon the lamb and onion mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Drizzle the liquid cheese over the lamb mixture.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Place the pastry in the agave leaf vessel and bake for 2 hours, or until the pastry is golden brown and the lamb is tender.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
